Preview: Shape rendered in the internal preview: torus or fat torus. Does not change the material.
Tint: Surface colour of the jelly where it is thin.
Deepcolor: Colour the light is absorbed towards where the jelly is thick.
Wrap: Wrap-lighting amount: how far diffuse light wraps past the terminator. 0 = standard diffuse, 1 = very soft.
Translucency: Strength of back-light bleeding through the body. 0 = opaque.
Rimglow: Gain of the glow at grazing view angles. 0 = no rim.
Absorption: Beer-Lambert absorption strength; higher values reach Deepcolor sooner.
Thickness: Scale of the approximated thickness (view angle plus noise). Higher = looks thicker and darker.
Innernoise: Amount of internal density variation from noise. 0 = uniform jelly.
Noisescale: Frequency of the internal noise. Larger = finer detail.
Specpower: Specular sharpness. Higher = smaller, tighter highlights.
Jiggle: Amplitude of the vertex wobble in world units. 0 = rigid.
Jigglefreq: Spatial frequency of the wobble across the mesh.
Jigglespeed: Wobble cycles per preview cycle (whole number so the preview loops).
Spin: Preview only: whole revolutions of the object per preview cycle. 0 = static.
Camdistance: Preview only: camera distance in world units.
Resolution: Preview only: size in pixels of the internal preview render.
